status: provisional seed; not an admission-sized independent holdout

tif-wrong-district.rationale: Distinct district identity; shared Dallas/TIF tokens establish no equivalence.

tif-farmers-city-center.rationale: Distinct district identity; aggregation does not make the bodies identical.

tif-grand-park-zone06.rationale: Conflicting name/number needs investigation; never overwrite official title.

tif-dallas-aggregate.rationale: The approved city subscription groups distinct TIF district boards.

tif-zone-marker.rationale: The approved aggregate covers TIF zone variants.

tif-ethics.rationale: Approved TIF scope includes oversight bodies.

tif-joint.rationale: Both represented bodies belong to the aggregate; do not double-add the GUID.

tif-unmarked-joint.rationale: The reviewed joint exception is supported; it does not license all DDA recordings.

tif-multifamily.rationale: TIF must be a token/family marker, not part of multifamily.

tif-beautiful.rationale: Beautiful is not a TIF identity marker.

tif-woodhaven.rationale: Approved aggregate migration covers the district and duplicated provider label.

tif-duplicate-views.rationale: Provider observations across views are not independent meetings.

tif-cross-city.rationale: A city aggregate cannot cross source/city ownership.

tif-pid.rationale: PID is a different district family, not TIF.

tif-unmarked-neighborhood.rationale: A neighborhood name does not establish board identity.

tif-topic-only.rationale: Council discussing TIF is not a district board.

denton-dated-family.rationale: Date/occurrence qualifiers do not change public-body identity.

few-recordings.rationale: Observation count does not determine independent body identity.

bond-family.rationale: Approved bond subscription policy spans programs/years.

charter-years.rationale: Maintainer approved one city feed per time-limited family.

canceled-unknown.rationale: Need recording/agenda evidence; uncertain truth stays outside accuracy scoring.

tv-show.rationale: Approved policy excludes municipal TV shows from meeting remediation.

staff-training.rationale: Approved format policy excludes training; title does not prove proceedings.

proposed-community.rationale: Recommendation D groups projects under one public-input subscription.

sign-distinct.rationale: Official city page lists them separately.

same-topic-not-body.rationale: Shared capital-improvement topic does not establish identity; inspect agendas.
